# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| 1.0.x   | :white_check_mark: |
| < 1.0   | :x:                |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

We take the security of EduPlan NG, teacher records, and Nigerian academic data very seriously.

If you discover a security vulnerability, please **DO NOT** open a public GitHub issue. Instead, report it via encrypted email to:

`security@eduplan.ng`

Please include:
1. Description of the vulnerability and attack vector.
2. Steps to reproduce or proof-of-concept payload.
3. Impact assessment on user accounts or database integrity.

Our security engineering response team will acknowledge your report within 24 hours and issue a coordinated fix within 72 hours.
